name: demo-video
description: Use when the user wants a demo, LinkedIn or product video of a web UI or a terminal CLI (dashboard, live simulation, Claude Code session) with zoom-ins on panels, a title card, burned-in captions, red highlight boxes, a highlight reel from longer takes, or a narrated reel; also when captioning a screen recording (.mov) they made themselves. Headless Linux with Playwright, ttyd and ffmpeg. Fork of hi-space/hi-aws-skills demo-video-recorder 1.2.0 (MIT); changes per version in CHANGELOG.md. Korean triggers: 데모 영상, 시연 영상, 링크드인 영상, 영상 녹화, 화면 녹화 편집, 자막 넣어줘, 하이라이트 릴, 릴 만들어줘.
